objective: Isolate and diagnose incomplete Olinto Pai Brazil/remote searches (120/373 boards; 1 confirmed; 40 pending; 120s cutoff); compare against proven historical search behaviors and current live sources.
allowed_changes: Read-only baseline audit of source response counts, run duration, filters, terminal history and all catalog scan stages
Capture real canary evidence by account and source, with denominators and reproducible regressions
Apply only code-level search fixes backed by observed failures after separate testing, exclusively in this canary
Re-use existing collection and search machinery; measure before and after; verify no father/Marcus/junior contamination
forbidden_changes: Main or production Render/Neon deployments, writes to original user records, accounts, passwords, history, saved profile or candidates
Changes to CV/ATS, scoring, recommendation, profile handling, registrations or authentication
New paid services, new collection mechanisms, GitHub Actions and Vercel, or unverified search broadening
Any merge into main without a separate explicit approval
acceptance: Canary bootstraps from exact production main commit, with separate Neon copy and fresh session secret
Evidence per source proves where candidates are lost: collection, role, time, country, mode, history or timeout
Any fix has red/green regression and negative cross-profile cases
Production and existing Olinto Filho canary are unmodified
deployment: Dedicated Render free service, manual deploy, unique URL; Neon child of production branch only; no main writes.
